notes.title: Patch Notes for Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session V1.2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session[/b] V1.2.0:

- Fixed Achievement Unlock Issue affecting 100.00% issue.

notes.title: V1.1.0 OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Hey! Thanks for your freaking feedback! OIJS cost me millions and billions of dollars to make, so I want it to be at least playable. -anyways I added some of your guys's and gals's suggestions and junk! Enjoy!

Patch Notes:
- You can now use Arrow Keys.
- You can hold the "R" key to quick restart a level.
- You can disable backgrounds.
- Other Secrets. :)
- Removed Dallenbrine.
